name: Create a graphic post index with dates and large linked titles
query: Create a full-width Query Loop pattern that lists three posts with date blocks on the left, large linked post titles, strong horizontal separators, and previous/next pagination.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route to wp-patterns and confirm this is a Query Loop pattern, not runtime PHP
Step 2: Use core/query with core/post-template and post blocks for date and title
Step 3: Make dates and linked titles part of the visual hierarchy with block-native typography and separator borders
Step 4: Include query pagination using native pagination blocks
Step 5: Include query-no-results fallback where relevant
Step 6: Avoid get_posts(), the_title(), or other query-time PHP
Step 7: Verify inherited/non-inherited query behavior and editor parsing
success_criteria: Uses Query Loop, Post Template, Post Date, Post Title, and Query Pagination blocks
Large linked titles and dates create a graphic editorial index
Uses block attributes for separators, spacing, and typography
Includes no-results fallback or explains why it is not needed
Does not use query-time PHP functions
Maintains accessible link text through linked post title blocks
Verification covers query settings and pagination
